scope: Historical development mechanism evidence only; no campaign validation outcomes inspected or used for design.

capture_quiescence.hypothesis: Fixed four-ply rollout leaves sometimes evaluate unfinished exchanges. Continue the existing masked policy for up to four capture decisions, stopping before its next quiet move.
capture_quiescence.native_fixture: A root capture worth +10 becomes -20 after the disclosed immediate recapture.
capture_quiescence.comparison_to_fixed_eight: Agreement rises from 72/140 for ordinary fixed-four to 86/140 for capture-quiescent-four. Fixed-eight is another heuristic, not a best-move label.
limitations: No strength improvement follows from move disagreement or agreement with deeper search.
The masked policy may miss a relevant capture or prefer a quiet tactical defense; extension stops there.
Quiet oscillations and permanently blocked routes are separate problems.

adaptive_sparse_root_horizon.hypothesis: Increase the horizon from four to eight only when the public root has at most twelve legal actions. Spend the saved root-width computation on longer continuations.
adaptive_sparse_root_horizon.threshold_basis: Doubling depth for twelve root actions has about the same masked-policy decision cost as four plies for a twenty-four-action root. The historical median is 22.5 actions; threshold twelve is a compute-budget rule, not fitted to wins.
limitations: Low mobility does not prove a true endgame or tactical instability.
A longer rollout repeats the same imperfect masked policy and may amplify its errors.
The sixteen-root subgroup is descriptive and supplies no strength estimate.

strategic_evaluation_review.finding: The pursuit distance ignores mobile blockers and does not check whether advancing toward the sampled Flag has adequate support against defenders. Consequently a quiet leaf can receive optimistic progress value even when its route is tactically unsafe.
strategic_evaluation_review.interpretation: This is a known structural limitation of the shaping function, not proof it caused a specific campaign loss. Native root scores may already offset some risk.
strategic_evaluation_review.avoid_duplicate_hypothesis: The rejected corridor information policy already attempted support and Miner access. Do not repackage a small support bonus as a new strategic idea; use explicit endpoint evidence and an isolated evaluation ablation if this is pursued.

privacy: Own setup and public histories only. All three variants use eight identical sampled worlds with equal RNG consumption; leaf masked-policy state/action invariance is tested under a concealed enemy-rank swap.
